source.heading: Galvanic Stim Digital High Volt
source.content:
PRODUCTS
 Electrotherapy Devices • Galvanic Stimulators 
 Galvanic Stim Digital High Volt

 Roll over to zoom in

 + View large image

 Galvanic Stim Digital High Volt

 Package Includes: Device, batteries, lead wires, 1 pack of 4 electrodes, carrying case and users manual.
 Most useful in acute injuries associated with major tissue trauma with bleeding or swelling
 Galvanic Stimulators apply direct current, creating and electrical field over the treated area
 The positive pad behaves like ice, causing reduced circulation to the area under the pad and reduction in swelling.
 The negative pad behaves like heat,causing increased circulation, reportedly speeding healing.

 PRODUCT CODE: DIGIGAL

 THERAPY INFO

 WARRANTY

 DESCRIPTION

Digital Galvanic Stimulation is most useful in acute injuries associated with major tissue trauma with bleeding or swelling. In contrast to TENS or IFC units, which apply alternating current,Galvanic Stimulators apply direct current. Direct current creates an electrical field over the treated area that, theoretically, changes blood flow and moves fluids. The positive pad behaves like ice, causing reduced circulation to the area under the pad and reduction in swelling. The negative pad behaves like heat, causing increased circulation, and reportedly can speed up the healing process.

High-voltage pulsed galvanic stimulation (HVPGS) is gaining widespread use for wound healing, edema reduction and pain relief, Carpal Tunnel Syndrome and Diabetic Foot are two major areas of use. Devices in this class are characterized by a unique twin- peak monophasic waveform with very short pulse duration (microseconds) and a therapeutic voltage greater than 100 volts. The combination of very short pulse duration and high peak current, yet low total current per second (Microcurrent) allows relatively comfortable stimulation. Furthermore, this combination provides an efficient means of exciting sensory, motor and pain-conducting nerve fibers. Perceptual discrimination of those responses is relatively easy to achieve and thus its clinical versatility. Back Ground Skin offers a great amount of resistance to the flow of electrical current. When current is passed through a circuit that contains resistors, voltage drop occurs and energy is lost. This phenomenon occurs when traditional low voltage units are used in treatment a high voltage device produces a spontaneous breakdown in skin resistance and HVPGS current passes through the skin with negligible thermal and electrochemical effects. The first high voltage stimulator was developed by Bell Telephone Laboratories in 1945. By decreasing the pulse duration and increasing the voltage, the developers noted that deep tissues could be stimulated without producing tissue damage. The first published report (I 966) described its effectiveness in wound healing of animal limbs. High-Voltage Pulsed Galvanic Stimulation

A prescription from your physician or physical therapist is required for this device.

response.answer:
Galvanic Stim Digital High Volt is PMT’s digital galvanic stimulator, designed for high-voltage pulsed galvanic stimulation (HVPGS).

Key points from the PMT information:

• Product name: Galvanic Stim Digital High Volt  
• Product code: DIGIGAL  
• Category: Galvanic Stimulators (electrotherapy device)

What it’s used for  
• Most useful in acute injuries associated with major tissue trauma with bleeding or swelling.  
• Indications include: muscle soreness, muscle stiffness, arthritis, body pain, post‑op pain, post‑traumatic acute pain, and chronic pain.  
• High-voltage pulsed galvanic stimulation is also widely used for wound healing and edema (swelling) reduction. Carpal Tunnel Syndrome and Diabetic Foot are two major areas of use.  
• A prescription from a physician or physical therapist is required for this device.

How galvanic stimulation works (per PMT description)  
• Unlike TENS or IFC, which use alternating current, this device uses direct current.  
• Direct current creates an electrical field over the treated area that can change blood flow and move fluids.  
• The positive pad behaves like ice, reducing circulation under the pad and helping reduce swelling.  
• The negative pad behaves like heat, increasing circulation and reportedly speeding healing.  
• Devices in this class use a twin‑peak monophasic waveform with very short pulse duration (microseconds) and therapeutic voltage greater than 100 volts.  
• The combination of very short pulse duration and high peak current, but low total current per second (microcurrent), allows relatively comfortable stimulation and efficient excitation of sensory, motor, and pain-conducting nerve fibers.

Technical specifications  
• Power: 9V battery or AC adaptor  
• Channel: Single channel with two active outputs and one dispersive return  
  – Active 1 and dispersive on CH1 output  
  – Active 2 on CH2 output  
• Output voltage: Adjustable, 0–350 V maximum (500 Ω load)  
• Waveform: Twin‑peaked monophasic, fixed interpulse interval 100 μs  
• Pulse rate: 1–120 Hz (adjustable, 1 Hz steps)  
• Pulse duration: 5 μs  
• Modes: Continuous, Alternating  

Package includes  
• Device  
• Batteries  
• Lead wires  
• 1 pack of 4 reusable electrode pads  
• Carrying case  
• User manual and electrode placement guide  

Physical specs  
• Product weight: 0.24375 lbs  
• Length: 3 cm  
• Width: 8 cm  
• Height: 10 cm  
• Weight code: G

Galvanic Stim Digital High Volt is PMT’s digital galvanic stimulator, designed for high-voltage pulsed galvanic stimulation (HVPGS).

Key points from the PMT information:

• Product name: Galvanic Stim Digital High Volt  
• Product code: DIGIGAL  
• Category: Galvanic Stimulators (electrotherapy device)

What it’s used for  
• Most useful in acute injuries associated with major tissue trauma with bleeding or swelling.  
• Indications include: muscle soreness, muscle stiffness, arthritis, body pain, post‑op pain, post‑traumatic acute pain, and chronic pain.  
• High-voltage pulsed galvanic stimulation is also widely used for wound healing and edema (swelling) reduction. Carpal Tunnel Syndrome and Diabetic Foot are two major areas of use.  
• A prescription from a physician or physical therapist is required for this device.

How galvanic stimulation works (per PMT description)  
• Unlike TENS or IFC, which use alternating current, this device uses direct current.  
• Direct current creates an electrical field over the treated area that can change blood flow and move fluids.  
• The positive pad behaves like ice, reducing circulation under the pad and helping reduce swelling.  
• The negative pad behaves like heat, increasing circulation and reportedly speeding healing.  
• Devices in this class use a twin‑peak monophasic waveform with very short pulse duration (microseconds) and therapeutic voltage greater than 100 volts.  
• The combination of very short pulse duration and high peak current, but low total current per second (microcurrent), allows relatively comfortable stimulation and efficient excitation of sensory, motor, and pain-conducting nerve fibers.

Technical specifications  
• Power: 9V battery or AC adaptor  
• Channel: Single channel with two active outputs and one dispersive return  
  – Active 1 and dispersive on CH1 output  
  – Active 2 on CH2 output  
• Output voltage: Adjustable, 0–350 V maximum (500 Ω load)  
• Waveform: Twin‑peaked monophasic, fixed interpulse interval 100 μs  
• Pulse rate: 1–120 Hz (adjustable, 1 Hz steps)  
• Pulse duration: 5 μs  
• Modes: Continuous, Alternating

 Neck Travel Pillow by Skypillow, One-of-a-kind Orthopedic Travel Pillow, Prevent Neck Cramps, Improve Posture; Memory Foam and Adjustable, Washable Cover, Includes Carrying Case and Clip (Blue) (SM)

 A BETTER NECK PILLOW: Many travel pillows aren't firm enough to properly support the neck and end up caving in to even the slightest amount of pressure. This does very little to actually help relieve neck pain or provide comfort during travel. The SkyPillow corrects this with sturdy memory foam construction that cradles the neck that reduces strain and keeps the head in an upright position.

 SIZING: Many neck pillows are intended for comfort during travel but standard neck pillows are often too small for the average adult. The average height of the neck is around 10-13 centimeters but generic pillows are typically only 6-8cm high, providing very little support for the neck. The Skypillow comes in two different sizes, both with an adjustable strap and a height of 12 centimeters to ensure that you can receive the right relief for you.

Small fits circumference: 12.5” – 14.5”

 ULTRA BREATHABLE FABRIC: The SkyPillow is constructed with a coolpass fabric that allows air to pass through the neck pillow. This breathable and lightweight fabric makes for a super comfortable pillow as the flow of air prevents the user from feeling overly constricted. During long periods of sitting or travel, it can be difficult to have something wrapped around your neck when the heat and sweat build. Keep your neck cool and comfy with the SkyPillow!

 CORRECT YOUR POSTURE: Neck Pain is most commonly attributed to poor posture which slowly builds up tension around the neck and shoulders. Treating the pain is one thing, but it doesn’t address the root of the problem. Correcting your posture is crucial to prevent the condition of the neck and shoulders from recurring or worsening. The Skypillow is meant to cradle the head, forcing it to remain in an upright and proper position which slowly corrects posture and prevents the buildup of further tension and pain.

 PATENTED DESIGN: Skypillow was designed with thorough consideration to provide the best experience possible. Not only does the Skypillow come in two different sizes, the adjustable clasp on the front allows it to be tightened to the specific width of your neck. Covering the pillow is a removable cover to make it incredibly easy to clean and replace. For additional convenience, the Skypillow is able to be folded into a third of its normal size and comes with a convenient carrying case for ease of packing. - TENS (Transcutaneous Electrical Nerve Stimulation)  
- EMS (Electrical Muscle Stimulation)  
- IFC (Interferential current)  
- Microcurrent

- Modes included:  
  - Enhanced TENS modes  
  - Enhanced EMS modes  
  - Advanced Interferential (IFC) with sine wave technology  
  - State‑of‑the‑art Microcurrent mode  
- Interface: Includes body part diagrams to help select appropriate programs/modes  
- Power:  
  - Operates on a high‑capacity lithium‑ion rechargeable battery  
  - 28v strength  
  - The Li‑ion battery allows:  
    - Use of Interferential mode without being plugged into a wall  
    - Long battery run time on TENS, EMS, and Microcurrent modes  
- Channels: Dual channel (you can run two lead wires/sets of electrodes at once)  
- Package includes:  
  - Ultima Neo device  
  - Batteries  
  - Lead wires  
  - 1 pack of 4 electrodes  
  - Carrying case  
  - User’s manual

source.heading: NerveSpa Pro - 90 Day Supply
source.content:
PRODUCTS
 Electrotherapy Devices • Neuropathy Stimulator 
 NerveSpa Pro - 90 Day Supply

 Roll over to zoom in

 + View large image

 NerveSpa Pro - 90 Day Supply

Clinical Device

Advanced Hand & Foot Neuropathy System for Provider-Guided Aquatic Nerve Stimulation

 Relieve Pain – Helps relieve nerve discomfort, tingling, sensitivity, and hand-and-foot pain through repeated-use care plans.
 Stimulate Nerves – Supports broader circumferential nerve engagement across the hands and feet than limited pad-only systems.
 Improve Circulation – Warm-water immersion and stimulation work together to support circulation-oriented extremity care.
 Extend Care Home – Built for clinic-to-home continuity, compliance, and repeated-use implementation over a longer care window.
 Support Long-Term Nerve Health – Designed for structured, repeated use to support nerve function, circulation, and ongoing neuropathy care.

 PRODUCT CODE: NSFBPRO90

 THERAPY INFO

 WARRANTY

 DESCRIPTION

Clinical Overview

The NerveSpa Pro is an advanced aquatic nerve stimulation system designed for provider-guided care pathways involving the hands and feet. NerveSpa therapy combines warm-water immersion, proprietary programming, and hybrid electrotherapy concepts intended to engage nerve-related tissue in a broader and more circumferential way than standard surface-only pad systems.

The system is built around an LCD touch screen device with a built-in microprocessor and programmed sequences using both biphasic and monophasic wave forms at 7.83 Hz across Programs A, B, and C.

In clinic positioning, the goal is to help communicate to the nerve, support soft-tissue rebuilding pathways, relieve pain, support circulation, and extend continuity of care.

Clinical Applications

 Nerve and neuropathy support protocols affecting the feet and hands
 Pain relief applications for nerve discomfort, tingling, sensitivity, and fatigue
 Circulation-oriented support involving the lower extremities
 Provider-guided home-use continuity for hand and foot nerve support
 Adjunctive use in broader nerve recovery, soft-tissue, and comfort-focused workflows
 Patients seeking a noninvasive, drug-free nerve support option

Quick Specs

 Product Code: NSFBPRO90
 Channels: Single channel
 Program: 90-day supply

NerveSpa Pro Features

Hybrid Electrotherapy Programming
The device uses biphasic and monophasic wave forms at 7.83 Hz across three programmed phases to create a guided sequence designed to support nerve communication, pain relief, and soft-tissue rebuilding pathways.
Program A: 11 minutes • Program B: 5 minutes • Program C: 14 minutes

Touch Screen Microprocessor System
A built-in microprocessor manages the programmed output sequence through a simple LCD touch screen layout with backlight, creating a more advanced experience than fixed-output stimulation systems.

90-Day Professional Supply Kit
The 90-day kit is configured to support repeated-use program continuity with the core device plus conductive solution components used as part of the aquatic therapy workflow.
Includes 32 oz. conductive Epsom salt and 180 effervescent tablets.

Clinical Pathways — In Clinic & At Home

Nerve and Neuropathy Support
NerveSpa Pro is positioned to support nerve and neuropathy care pathways affecting the hands and feet through repeated provider-guided stimulation sessions.

Pain Relief Support
The system is designed to help relieve pain and improve patient-reported comfort during repeated-use care plans targeting nerve-related discomfort.

Circulation-Oriented Support
Warm-water immersion and stimulation are used together to support circulation-oriented treatment goals involving the extremities.

Clinic-to-Home Continuity
The system is structured for repeated use across an extended care window, making it well suited for provider-guided continuity beyond isolated treatment visits.

Note:
In clinic positioning, outcomes are framed as cumulative with consistency and repeated use over time.

NerveSpa Pro is best suited for providers seeking a differentiated nerve-support modality that combines aquatic delivery, programmed waveform sequencing, and home continuity.

Why This Modality Stands Out

 Warm-water immersion: supports comfort and circulation-oriented care pathways
 Circumferential coverage: underwater delivery provides broader tissue contact than limited pad-only zones
 Programmed sequencing: 30-minute total protocol with distinct phase timing supports structured implementation
 Smooth sensation: designed to feel smooth, engulfing, and uniform during use
 Drug-free support pathway: positioned as a noninvasive option within broader provider-guided care plans

Technical Specifications

 Channels
 Single channel (dual channel system available)
 Directional Flow of Current
 Travels up one leg to the lower back and down the other leg
 Wave Form
 Biphasic & monophasic wave forms
 Frequency
 7.83 Hz for Program A, Program B, and Program C
 Programs
 Mode A: Microcurrent/Galvanic Stim – Monophasic – 11 minutes
 Mode B: Microcurrent/Galvanic Stim – Biphasic – 5 minutes
 Mode C: Microcurrent/Galvanic Stim – Monophasic – 14 minutes
 Battery
 Lithium-ion rechargeable
 Screen Type
 LCD touch screen with simple layout and backlight
 Lead Wires
 Enhanced Tiger Wires
 Water Resistant
 Yes
 Sensation
 Smooth, engulfing, and uniform
 Device Dimensions
 2.5" W x 4.5" L x .5" D
 Foot Bath Dimensions
 9" W x 14" L x 10" D
 Compliance
 FDA Cleared – OTC
 Warranty / Guarantee
 1-year warranty
 60 days return without restocking fee
 Conductive Solution
 Conductive Epsom Salt – 32 oz. / 180 effervescent tablets

Suggested Use Considerations

 Protocol Length: 30-minute total session structure using Programs A, B, and C
 Coverage: designed for hand and foot nerve stimulation support
 Consistency: intended to be used repeatedly across a longer-term care window
 Clinical Role: best positioned within a broader provider-guided nerve support plan
 Setup: use within the intended aquatic protocol and conductive solution workflow

User Guide

Review the NerveSpa FootBath User Guide for setup, operation, maintenance, and treatment workflow instructions.

View User Guide

How It Works Video

Watch the overview video to see how the NerveSpa FootBath is set up and used within the treatment workflow.
